metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for ProcessPoolExecutor worker lifecycle configuration. It differs semantically and operationally from peer ThreadPoolExecutor skills (context manager, worker initialization, worker count) and existing skills (reward function design, vLLM deployment). No existing skill covers ProcessPoolExecutor-specific parameters (mp_context, start method, max_tasks_per_child). The candidate addresses a separate executor type and lifecycle stage with unique constraints (fork/spawn/forkserver, Python 3.14 deprecation, pickling requirements). Support evidence from concurrent.futures documentation validates the capability.
